solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: A record, third in chart, about woolly animal

parts.note: LP is a long-playing record

indicators.note: asks for the third letter of the word chart, counting from the front

parts.note: CA is circa, Latin for about

explanation.surface: A record-breaking animal climbing to number three in the charts, with some woolly approximation.
explanation.definitionFit: The alpaca is a South American camelid kept for its soft fleece, so a woolly animal fits.

clue.text: Room in shelter on course

parts.note: the lee is the sheltered side, away from the wind
a way is a route or course

explanation.surface: Space found in a hut on the golf course.
explanation.definitionFit: Room in the sense of latitude or margin to manoeuvre, a close synonym.

clue.text: Writer of sexual drama, end horrific

indicators.note: something horrific is ghastly and disordered, so the letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A literary critic panning the closing scene of a steamy play.
explanation.walkthrough: 'horrific' rearranges the fourteen letters of SEXUAL DRAMA END into the two-word name.
explanation.definitionFit: Alexandre Dumas wrote The Three Musketeers and The Count of Monte Cristo, a famous French novelist.

clue.text: Plant a girl put on shelf tipped over

parts.note: Mary is a girl's name

indicators.note: in a down clue something tipped over is upended, so the word for shelf is read bottom to top

parts.note: a sill is a shelf below a window

explanation.surface: A young woman puts a pot plant on a shelf and knocks it over.
explanation.definitionFit: Amaryllis is a bulb plant with large trumpet flowers, an example of a plant.

clue.text: Team members producing weapons

parts.note: a side is a team in sport
arms are limbs, members of the body

explanation.surface: Players on a squad turning out weaponry.
explanation.definitionFit: Sidearms are pistols or swords carried at the belt, a kind of weapon.

clue.text: Infected having caught cold? I may doubt that

indicators.note: the word for infected has caught, so holds, the abbreviation for cold

parts.note: a septic wound is infected
C is the standard abbreviation for cold, as on taps

explanation.surface: Someone told they have an infection on top of a cold responds with disbelief.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is spoken by the answer: a doubter is someone who might say 'I may doubt that'.
explanation.definitionFit: A doubter or disbeliever is the person who would say these words, so the phrase stands for one.

clue.text: Wild dog daughter, at home, shot

parts.note: in means at home
a go is a shot or attempt

explanation.surface: A feral dog in the house, and the daughter fires at it.
explanation.definitionFit: The dingo is the wild dog of Australia, so this is a direct description.

clue.text: US politician needs salvation, possibly

indicators.note: possibly says the letters given are one possible arrangement, so they may be shuffled

explanation.surface: An American politician in need of redemption, perhaps.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' rearranges NEEDS SALVATION into the two-word name.
explanation.definitionFit: Adlai Stevenson was a Democrat twice nominated for the presidency, in 1952 and 1956.

clue.text: Wine, extremely drinkable, in Oman's capital

indicators.note: the outer letters go inside the name of the capital

parts.note: Muscat is the capital city of Oman

indicators.note: takes the extremes, the first and last letters, of drinkable

explanation.surface: Wine that is highly drinkable, served in Oman's capital city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Oman's capital' tempts you to take the first letter, O, but here it means the capital city itself; 'extremely' picks the two ends of 'drinkable'.
explanation.definitionFit: Muscadet is a dry white wine from the Loire valley in France.

clue.text: Commercial breaking into cool piece of romantic music

indicators.note: the commercial breaks into, so goes inside, the word for cool

parts.note: serene means calm, cool
an ad is a commercial

explanation.surface: An advert interrupting a calm, romantic piece of music on the radio.
explanation.definitionFit: A serenade is a song a lover sings beneath a window, music with a romantic purpose.

clue.text: Number lower, would you believe!

parts.note: less means lower in amount

explanation.surface: An astonished exclamation that a figure has dropped.
explanation.definitionFit: Said as an exclamation of surprise, this two-word phrase means 'if you please' or 'fancy that'.

clue.text: Splendid gathering happy to be shown round Los Angeles Times?

indicators.note: the word for happy goes round the two pieces like a guide showing them round

parts.note: gay in its older sense means merry, happy
X is the times or multiplication sign

explanation.surface: A happy visitor being given a tour of the Los Angeles Times newspaper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Los Angeles Times' reads as the newspaper but splits into LA and X.
explanation.definitionFit: A galaxy is a brilliant assembly of stars, used figuratively of a dazzling crowd of celebrities.

clue.text: Very hot part — coil defective

indicators.note: a defective part is faulty and out of order, so its letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A faulty coil overheating in some machine part.
explanation.definitionFit: Tropical describes the hot, humid climate of the tropics, hence extremely hot.

clue.text: US writer of verse, crack shot

indicators.note: shot means got rid of, so the word for crack is thrown out of the word for verse

parts.note: poetry is verse
a crack is an attempt, a try

explanation.surface: An American poet who was also an expert marksman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crack shot' reads as a marksman; split, 'crack' is TRY and 'shot' means discarded.
explanation.definitionFit: Edgar Allan Poe was an American author of tales and poems such as The Raven.

clue.text: Eats bananas in specially licensed premises selling food

indicators.note: the jumbled eats go inside the jumbled licensed
specially, as in specially arranged, signals that licensed is rearranged
bananas means crazy, so the letters of eats go wild

explanation.surface: Bananas are eaten at a specially licensed food shop.
explanation.walkthrough: Both 'bananas' and 'specially' are anagram signals, one for each word; the shuffled four letters go inside the shuffled eight, so the definition comes last.
explanation.definitionFit: A delicatessen is a shop selling prepared foods such as cooked meats and cheeses.

clue.text: Carriage entrance

definitions.meaning: carriage as the conveying of goods or people
to entrance is to enrapture, to carry away with delight

explanation.walkthrough: 'entrance' is not a doorway but the verb pronounced en-TRANCE.
explanation.definitionFit: Both a noun for conveyance and a verb for sending someone into raptures share this one word.

clue.text: See 7
Adult in favour of wearing long apron

indicators.note: the word for long wears, so encloses, the other pieces

parts.note: to pine is to long for
A is the film-rating abbreviation for adult
for means in favour of

explanation.surface: A grown-up keen on wearing a long apron.
explanation.definitionFit: A pinafore is a sleeveless apron-like garment worn over clothes to keep them clean.

clue.text: As a rule, gives free savoury paste

indicators.note: free means loose and unconstrained, so the letters are let out of order

explanation.surface: Someone who habitually hands out a savoury spread at no charge.
explanation.definitionFit: Liver sausage is a soft spreadable sausage of cooked liver, eaten like pâté.

clue.text: Steal from some characters in Cairo bar

indicators.note: only some of the letters of Cairo bar are taken, a run lying inside them

explanation.surface: Robbing a drinking den in Egypt's capital.
explanation.definitionFit: To steal from someone is to rob them, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Unfortunate, a French girl swallowing potassium

parts.note: un is French for a

indicators.note: the girl swallows, so holds inside, the symbol for potassium

parts.note: Lucy is a girl's name
K is the chemical symbol for potassium

explanation.surface: An unfortunate French girl who has swallowed a dose of potassium.
explanation.definitionFit: Unlucky means having bad luck, the same as unfortunate.

clue.text: Recited flourishing novelist

indicators.note: recited means spoken out, so the word sounds like the answer

parts.note: green means flourishing, as of healthy vegetation

explanation.surface: A thriving author reading their work out loud.
explanation.definitionFit: Graham Greene was the English writer of Brighton Rock and The Power and the Glory.

clue.text: With book in college defining game

indicators.note: the two pieces are placed inside the word for college

parts.note: a hall is a college or residence, as at a university
and means with, together with

explanation.surface: A college that defines a sport by the book.
explanation.definitionFit: Handball is a team sport in which players throw a ball into a goal.

clue.text: See 3
Help receiving little credit could make one bitter

indicators.note: the word for help receives, so holds, the short form for credit

parts.note: aid means help
CR is an abbreviation, a little version, of credit

explanation.surface: Being given only a little credit for helping could leave anyone resentful.
explanation.definitionFit: Acrid means sharp and bitter, of a taste, smell or temper.

clue.text: Slip up in attempt to get drink

indicators.note: the slip-up goes inside the word for attempt

parts.note: a shy is a throw or attempt, as at a coconut shy
to err is to slip up or make a mistake

explanation.surface: Making a mistake while trying to get a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Sherry is a fortified wine from Jerez in Spain, a type of drink.

clue.text: Old prior departed long ago

definitions.meaning: gone in the past, belonging to earlier times

explanation.surface: An elderly monk of the past who died many years back.
explanation.definitionFit: Each phrase is a synonym for previous or earlier, all meanings of the one adjective.

clue.text: Dish cut into pieces, the old American recalled

parts.note: to chop is to cut into pieces

indicators.note: recalled means called back, so the two pieces are read backwards

parts.note: ye is an old form of the

explanation.surface: An old American remembers a meal served in chopped-up pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Chop suey is a Chinese-American dish of stir-fried meat and vegetables.

clue.text: Fine — new date, say, for a religious celebration

parts.note: F is the pencil-grading abbreviation for fine

indicators.note: new says the letters of date and say are made into something new

explanation.surface: Someone agrees a fresh date for a church festival.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' rearranges DATE and SAY together into EASTDAY.
explanation.definitionFit: A feast day is a day of religious festival, such as a saint's day in the church calendar.

clue.text: Kind offer

definitions.meaning: kind as in gentle, caring, soft-hearted
to offer formally, as in ... a bid or resignation

explanation.definitionFit: The adjective means gentle and caring, and the verb means formally to put forward.
